name: KGQuestionnaire
title: Knowledge graph L3: Questionnaire
description: A FHIR Questionnaire -- a data-collection form over a logical model. 10 in the immunizations IG. Its `sdc-questionnaire-targetStructureMap` extension names the StructureMap that extracts it, which is a real canonical reference. The SOP states no linkId convention and none exists in the estate, so no edge is licensed on linkId. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/questionnaire.

element.definition: A FHIR Questionnaire -- a data-collection form over a logical model. 10 in the immunizations IG. The canonical URL. Only a resolved component carries one.
The FHIR resource type.
A profile canonical the artefact declares (meta.profile or the requirement's profile).
The resource's status (FHIR PublicationStatus).
The business version, as declared.
The human-readable title.
The computable name: the CamelCase identifier a Canonical() reference matches on.
The publisher, as declared.
The resource's experimental flag.
Where the node was read from: a repository path or URL.
Hash of the file the node was read from; pins the source.
